Documentation requirements for exchange students  – Østfold University of Applied Sciences
Documentation requirements for exchange students
Both the nominator and the student can submit documentation in the application. It is up to the nominator to decide who should upload relevant documentation.  It is important that all required documentation is uploaded within the application deadline.
Please upload documents in PDF or JPG format and name the documents so we understand what they contain.
Necessary documentation
Erasmus+ students
Transcripts of Record
of higher education in English (or in original language with a translated copy)
Erasmus+ Learning Agreement for studies:
Applicants are encouraged to submit an
online learning agreement (OLA).
how to fill out your OLA
Students unable to assess OLA may upload a OUAS'
paper version of the Learning Agreement
or your home university’s version in your application.
Erasmus+ Learning Agreement for traineeship
(completed in word, printed and then signed and stamped by the student and home institution) Students may also use the standard Erasmus+ form from their home institution.
Copy of passport
(photo ID page only) or National ID card (EU/EEA- students)
OUAS will sign the Learning Agreement and return it to the student when the application is processed.  If you want to make changes to your already approved Learning Agreement, you may do this after arrival in the section called "During mobility".
Bilateral students
Official Transcripts of Record
of higher education in English (or in original language with a translated copy)
Application form
(signed and stamped by the student and home institution)
Documentation of English language skills
(IELTS, TOEFL, PTE, Cambridge or other documentation. Does not apply for native speakers)
Copy of passport
(photo ID page only)
Additional documentation
Certain faculties require additional documents:
Health and welfare sciences students (traineeship/placement)
Proof of negative MRSA test and, in some cases, Tuberculosis test*
Police clearance certificate stating that the student has no criminal records*
*Please note that these documents are
not
to be uploaded into the application portal as they contain sensitive information. These documents must be presented to the Faculty of Health and Welfare Sciences before the start of the semester.
